The launch of NuPlay follows Nurix.ai's recent $27 million funding round led by General Catalyst and Accel. Over the past six months, the company has grown 5x quarter on quarter, rapidly scaling its customer base in the US, demonstrating market demand and the scalability of its solutions.

NuPlay is generally available today. Learn how NuPlay can help enterprises establish lasting brand loyalty at scale here. [...] "Most AI tools today generate conversations, largely over text; however, that's not how meaningful human-to-human interactions take place," said Mukesh Bansal, founder and CEO of Nurix.AI. Customers seek meaningful interactions where they are truly listened to, and brands that prioritize scaling quality customer service are the ones that will build lasting loyalty. NuPlay is enabling people to interact with AI agents in the same way they would with a sales rep or customer support team, fostering genuine engagement, gathering information, and accelerating decision-making seamlessly within enterprise operations."
